description: Czarnobog, the Slavic god of darkness, a towering figure made of black smoke and night with faint stars glinting inside it, a tall crown of black iron spikes, cold pale glowing eyes in a dark faceless head, a long black cloak dissolving into darkness at its edges, long clawed shadow hands, majestic and menacing, standing, full body, three-quarter view, no wings, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
